Command.Comment: RAGIN python route discovery via SSM script file

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
SRC="/opt/ragin/ragin/server_v2.py"
echo SRC=$SRC
if [ ! -f "$SRC" ]; then
  echo SRC_MISSING=yes
  exit 2
fi
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast, json, pathlib, sys
p = pathlib.Path("/opt/ragin/ragin/server_v2.py")
tree = ast.parse(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
routes = []
for node in ast.walk(tree):
    if isinstance(node, (ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.FunctionDef)):
        name = getattr(node, "name", None)
        if not name:
            continue
        first = (p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[node.lineno-1] if node.lineno else "").strip()
        routes.append({"line": node.lineno, "name": name, "first_line": first})
print(json.dumps(routes, indent=2))
PY
echo DONE
